newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Sphere Drake Insurance at BBB.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Sphere Drake Insurance at BBB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it affirmed its BBB claims-paying ability raings of Sphere Drake Insurance Plc (SDI) and Sphere Drake Insurance (Bermuda) Ltd (SDIBL).

"The affirmation responds to the parent company, Sphere Drake Holdings Ltd's announcement today of the results of its strategic review of the group's insurance and reinsurance operations," S&P said in a statement.
S&P said it viewed the announcement as supportive of its rating level.

In its last public announcement regarding Sphere Drake (April 1996, when lowering the rating to BBB from BBB plus), S&P welcomed the more conservative bias of the new management team and management's desire to achieve greater operational stability.
"Based on our recent meeting with sphere Drake management, S&P believes Sphere Drake has made good progress towards achieving this goal," the agency said.
